match_stages.stage_briefing:
*This is currently a USPSA Provisional Classification Stage*

Written Stage Briefing
CM 26-04 Uprange? Seriously is a 12 round, 60 point Comstock Classifier course. 
There are 6 USPSAtargets. The best 2 hits per target will score. 

The start signal is audible.

The Handgun Start Position is standing completely outside of the shooting area, facing downrangewith heels touching the start marks.
Handgun is loaded and holstered with wrists below belt.

The PCC Start Position is standing completely outside of the shooting area, facing downrange withheels touching the start marks. 
Carbine is loaded with stock touching belt.

The Make Ready position is at the start position.On the start signal, engage the targets from the shooting area.

*This is currently a USPSA Provisional Classification Stage*

Written Stage Briefing
CM 26-05 Downrange? Obviously is a 12 round, 60 point Comstock Classifier course. 
There are 6USPSA targets. The best 2 hits per target will score. 
The start signal is audible.

The Handgun Start Position is standing completely outside of the shooting area facing downrangewith toes touching the start marks. 
Handgun is loaded and holstered with wrists below belt.

The PCC Start Position is standing completely outside of the shooting area facing downrange withtoes touching the start marks. 
Carbine is loaded with stock touching belt.

The Make Ready position is at the start position.On the start signal, engage the targets from the shooting area.

*This is currently a USPSA Provisional Classification Stage*

Written Stage Briefing
CM 26-01 King Crab is a 14 round, 70 point Comstock Classifier course. There are 6 IPSC targets and2 USPSA Mini-Poppers. The best 2 hits per target will score. Steel must fall to score. The start signalis audible.

The Handgun Start Position is standing completely outside of the shooting area with toes touchingthe start marks. 
Handgun is loaded and holstered with wrists below belt.

The PCC Start Position is standing completely outside of the shooting area with toes touching the startmarks. 
Carbine is loaded with stock touching belt.

The Make Ready position is at the start position.On the start signal, engage the targets from the shooting area.

The Roscoe Rattle is an 18 round, 90 point Virginia Count Classifier course. There are three Metric targets. The best six hits per target will score. The start signal is audible.

The start position is standing in Box A, facing uprange, fingers touching head above ears. PCC start position is standing in Box A, facing downrange, stock on belt, muzzle downrange, loaded carbine held in both hands with safety on.

String 1: On signal, from Box A only, turn and engage T2 with only 6 rounds.

String 2: On signal, from Box A only, turn and engage T1 with only 6 rounds, then make a mandatory reload, then engage T3 with only six rounds. No turn for PCC.
